description_full: CoinShares PLC engages in the creating financial products with digital assets and blockchain technology business in Jersey. It operates through three segments: Asset Management, Capital Markets, and Principal Investments. The company offers CoinShares Physical, CoinShares Valkyrie, CoinShares XBT, and The Blockchain Global Equity Index products. It also provides hedge fund solutions, indices, venture services, and capital markets services. CoinShares PLC was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Saint Helier, Jersey.

Stock-based compensation of $31K per employee reflects an ownership culture. CEO compensation is 2× revenue per employee (modest relative to workforce productivity).
financial_summary: CoinShares PLC is a small-cap financial services business with a $468M market cap on $163M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +38% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are contracting by -3.5pp, the first warning that competitive pressure is eroding the franchise.
Returns on capital run at 38% against a 13% cost of capital — a 25-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat. Gross margins of 76% confirm genuine pricing power.

The business throws off $122M in free cash flow — roughly 74 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.08× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 12× is fortress-like.

Management returns a meaningful 7.6% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 55% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and within its sector the business captures 2.2× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
